messages:
nina: Quick sync: Orion on-prem peering incident follow-up. Root cause summary: customer pushed a partial ACL change that removed NAT exemption for peer subnet during BGP flap. We need clear owners and short timelines for remediation items.

raj: Can we track this as two items: 1) infra automation guard to block ACL removals affecting active peer ranges, 2) runbook update + non-prod test harness. I'll own (1).

cecil: I'll pick up the runbook edits and add a maintenance checklist and escalation flow (owner: cecil, due: 2026-04-09). Will include exact verification commands.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4312 and linked postmortem: https://tracker.example.com/INC-4312 :ticket:

raj: Proposed automation guard pseudo-check (add to automation repo):
```bash
PEER_RANGE=192.168.100.0/24
if nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8050 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "peer-check OK"
else
  echo "ERROR: peer API down, aborting"
  exit 1
fi
# verify ACL does not remove peer range
if grep -q "$PEER_RANGE" /etc/acl/current; then
  echo "peer range present"
else
  echo "ERROR: removing active peer range"
  exit 1
fi
```

nina: Nice. raj, can you add a canary mode so rule removals are staged on a small set before global?

raj: Yep. I'll open PR for automation-guard v1.2 with canary gating. ETA 2026-04-06.

cecil: For the runbook I'll add a step to run a NAT table dump and BGP neighbor-state check, plus a quick sanity test script. Example commands I'll include: `show ip bgp summary` and `iptables -t nat -L -n`.

qa: I'll write a minimal test harness that simulates a BGP flap and ensures our healthcheck detects asymmetric path. Targeting 2026-04-12 for initial tests.

nina: Also adding a monitoring label to INC-4312: "peering-repeat-detect". If a customer hits 3 incidents in 60 days, auto-escalate to account engineering. cecil, please add that label.

cecil: Added label and linked to chronic-issues dashboard.

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy automation-guard v1.2 -> staging 2026-04-04 05:00 UTC, prod 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC.

raj: Accepted. I'll include rollback playbook in PR description.

nina: Recap owners/dates: raj (automation guard + canary) 2026-04-06, cecil (runbook + label) 2026-04-09, qa (test harness) 2026-04-12. INC-4312 tracks progress. React :white_check_mark: when acknowledged.
